description: A festival programmer must make the binding call on whether a submitted documentary belongs in the official competition or a single special screening, and must finalize the film's screening, promotion, and credit package.

shared_context.S1: The documentary 'After the Floodlights' has been submitted for the festival's official competition.
shared_context.S2: The draft program currently lists the documentary as a competition title with a planned public screening and an online trailer.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final programming decision and controls the public program listing.
shared_context.S4: At the daily programming review, Mara asks rights clearance and submissions staff to report any issue before the program is locked.

PF1.text: Jonas reviewed the executed music and archive license this morning and confirmed that the festival may hold exactly one in-person public screening, may not publish any trailer or excerpt online, and must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive'; he has not added the license summary to the programming file because the signed copy arrived in his separate clearance inbox.

PF2.text: Leila checked the filmmaker's signed premiere declaration against the festival database today and confirmed that 'After the Floodlights' already had a public screening at the Harbor Documentary Week, so it fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement and must instead be offered, if retained, as a single special screening; she has not updated the submission record because the database correction queue is still open.

acceptance_conditions: The documentary must be moved out of competition and retained as a special screening.
Exactly one in-person public screening must be scheduled.
No trailer or excerpt may be published online.
The exact Northline Archive credit must be used.
The eligibility record must be updated.
A rights-restriction notice must be logged.
The rights license fact must be cited by the programmer after being revealed.

decisive_facts.why: The executed license changes the package from a public screening with an online trailer to exactly one in-person screening, no online trailer, the exact Northline Archive credit, and a logged rights restriction.
The verified prior public screening changes the program status from competition to special screening and requires the eligibility record to be updated.
